clusters.headline: Global Leaders Convene In Turkey For The COP31 Climate Conference
aiSummaryBullets: Türkiye is hosting the UN-sponsored COP31 summit, placing global electrification at the forefront of the agenda.
The presidency proposes increasing global electricity demand to 35 percent by 2035, up from the current level of approximately 20 percent.

clusters.headline: United Nations COP31 Climate Change Summit Begins In Antalya Turkey
aiSummaryBullets: The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) is scheduled to begin on November 9 in Antalya.
Delegates will discuss implementing concrete measures to address the global climate crisis.
